sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Radiomics in thyroid nodule assessment》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】The purpose of this article is to systematize the utilization of radiomics in assessing thyroid nodules, aiming to furnish valuable theoretical insights.

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Through a scrutiny of the principles, methods, and applications of radiomics in thyroid nodule evaluation, we aim to elucidate its potential for enhancing diagnostic accuracy, assessing disease progression, and mitigating overdiagnosis.
